status: Candidate bounded offline startup, price publication and packaged-font checkpoint. Independent evidence review/integration pending; overall production readiness open.

firefoxRuntime.scope: Offline new-profile extension popup bootstrap and runtime CSP on local macOS152.0.4. Signed AMO installation/update, historical Firefox wallet upgrades and Linux CI remain separate gates.
firefoxRuntime.warningReview: Existing reviewed fingerprint unchanged; exact warning audit passes.

behavior: Remote registry failure falls back to valid cached/bundled networks; custom cached chains are excluded from authoritative discovery. Cache read/network requests are bounded; registry retry is shared and scheduled.

Unread network cache cannot be overwritten by startup or status polling. Recovered settings are merged before writes reopen. Readable-cache refresh preserves current favorites and manual/custom provider settings; saved bundled settings survive startup.
Balance startup reads the active cached map and leaves cached amounts untouched when APIs lack decorated query pallets. Substrate and Sora readiness rejections are owned.

Price subscriptions answer cache/empty state before network work; provider failures and hung requests are isolated. CoinGecko captures currency and owns keyed pending/cached results. Late provider/cache/store callbacks cannot publish older prices or undo explicit fiat selection.
Packaged fonts are local files in all three builds; CSP is unchanged and actual cyrillic-ext/vietnamese JetBrains faces load.
preservedDiagnostics: Original network8fail and price4fail/2unhandled baselines retained. Independent review baselines cover malformed options, unread cache, held preferences, CoinGecko currency/cache and write/publication races.
Fullv1/v2/v3 and productionv1/v2 are superseded for final-source acceptance. Focusedv9 exposes helper precedence regression, corrected without weakening the existing custom-node assertion.

Browserv1/v2 use a capped developer error list and cannot prove zero exceptions. Browserv3 installs Runtime.exceptionThrown before new worker execution and finds43 copied-profile failures. Browserv4 reduces these to one undecorated-query TypeError. Finalv5 has zero new-worker exceptions in both profiles.

The copied profile initially starts its prior cached worker and records two old Axios exceptions. Final gating explicitly identifies the newly paused extension worker sessions; old-session events remain in raw evidence and are not misrepresented as current-source exceptions.
Preference constructor and actual SubscribableStore acknowledgement baselines each reproduce two failures; final regressions pass.
remainingGates: OFF10: Explicit network edits during an unreadable-cache interval currently mutate memory but cannot persist, and repair can overwrite them. Add queued per-field intent or a truthful unavailable result before release; this checkpoint does not claim full network preference durability.
General network settings write acknowledgements, network callback ownership and mixed-worker behavior are not fully qualified.
Public provider reconnect/live service interoperability, complete screen/accessibility/brand rollout, final historical upgrade/private-chain checks and signed distribution remain open.
Native automatic JSON modal sequencing/Profile authentication, Android imported-wallet navigation, physical hardware and cross-platform release acceptance remain open.
